name: Snare Tactics (VST3)
description: A snare drum synthesiser: no samples, every hit synthesised. Studio snares, the classic drum machines, and snares for techno, dub, industrial and digital hardcore, from a head, a set of wires and a stick. The wires are the trick: driven by the head, they lag the stick, buzz at the drum's own pitch when loose and ring along with it. Rim shot, cross-stick and clap on the GM notes, a gated 80s room, a tempo-synced dub echo, four drives from Battlestar Overdrive, and forty-four presets in seven banks. Kickstart's sibling.
note: Windows VST3 + standalone · build 260926.4 · free download · 31 controls · snare, rim shot, cross-stick, clap · gated room + dub echo · 4 Battlestar drives · 44 presets · manual included.
